_comment: 4x4 torus toy (2026-10-20; toy_g, data/gtorus_id_ind.npz from toy_g/export_lt.py), existing-lineage baseline 1b: per-task puzzle identifier (task = t * 24 + c, 3,072 identifiers), inductive: train on the demonstration pairs of the 2,419 group-0 tasks only (7,257 pairs); test on all 3,072 test pairs, so held-out tasks are read with never-trained (zero) identifier rows. Recipe of configs/miniarc_c1p.json: per-identifier prefix token (URM/HRM, puzzle_emb_ndim = hidden: one prefix token), EMA of the embedding table, hidden 32, 2 heads, FFN 64 (2x), recurrent linear attention, 8 blocks x 2 segments, batch 128, lr 1e-3. test_size 3072 (the default 2048 would drop rows). test_group (eval: python -m toy_g.eval_lt CK): 0 train task 2,419, 1 held-out (t, c) combination 269, 2 task of a held-out transformation 384.
